jobs.title: Director, Software Development
jobs.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

We are looking for a Director of Software Development to lead a key area of our Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform. In this role, you will build and lead a new engineering team in Austin while driving the delivery of a strategic initiative that helps Managed Service Providers (MSPs) monitor, automate, and optimize digital employee experiences across large customer environments.

You will be responsible for defining technical direction, building a high-performing team, and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations leaders to deliver scalable, reliable solutions that create measurable customer value.

As part of TeamViewer's AI-native engineering transformation, you will also help establish and evolve engineering practices that leverage AI-assisted development while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and reliability.

Responsibilities

Build, hire, and lead a new software engineering team in Austin, establishing a strong engineering culture and operating model.
Own the delivery of a strategic, multi-phase DEX initiative that serves MSP customers at scale.
Define and execute the technical roadmap for your area in alignment with the broader DEX platform strategy.
Drive the full software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and customer-focused.
Partner with engineering, product, and operational leaders to align priorities and execution across teams.
Establish engineering best practices, development standards, and quality processes that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining strong technical foundations.
Champion the effective adoption of AI-assisted development practices and help shape the organization's evolving AI engineering strategy.
Coach and develop engineering leaders and senior engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Proven experience leading and growing software engineering organizations, including building or scaling teams.
Track record of delivering large-scale SaaS or cloud-based platforms.
Strong technical background with experience in modern distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.
Experience introducing and scaling AI-assisted software development practices within engineering teams.
Ability to balance technical excellence, product priorities, and business outcomes.
Experience setting engineering standards, development practices, and quality expectations across teams.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, product, and business functions.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where team, product, and process are evolving simultaneously.

Preferred Experience

Experience with MSP, endpoint management, IT operations, or digital employee experience platforms.
Familiarity with technologies such as C#, Azure, Kubernetes, Kafka, Databricks, SQL Server, and related cloud-native tooling.
Experience leading teams that use AI coding agents, such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, in production delivery at scale
Working knowledge of model-based failure modes (hallucination, context degradation, prompt injection, non-determinism)

How We Work

We believe AI-assisted development will play an increasingly important role in how software is built and delivered. Engineering leaders at TeamViewer are expected to leverage modern AI development tools while ensuring strong engineering discipline, governance, testing, and quality standards remain at the center of the software delivery process.

You will help shape how these practices evolve across the organization while collaborating with peers to establish consistent and scalable approaches.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation and bonuses
Flexible PTO and paid holidays
401(k) with employer matching
Comprehensive Health insurance package including 100% employer-paid medical coverage
Up to 12 weeks of Parental Leave
Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term & Long-Term Disability, 100% employer-paid
Quarterly teambuilding events, leadership luncheons, and companywide “All Hands” meetings
Open door policy and business casual dress code
We celebrate diversity as one of our core values. Join c-a-r-e and lead change initiatives together with us!

Work location for this position is Austin, TX.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Join ProMach and shine. Whether you're creative, strategic, persuasive, or mechanically inclined, there’s a place for you here. Be a problem-solver, a closer, a futurist - whatever drives you.

At ProMach, you'll be challenged and rewarded as you help improve packaging performance and shape the future of automation. And we’ll be proud to have you on the journey.

Do we have your attention?
Keep reading.

Matrix Packaging Machinery, a division of ProMach, is an industry leader in vertical, form, fill, and seal packaging. As the Director of Engineering, you will provide strategic leadership and operational direction to a multi-disciplinary engineering team responsible for developing and supporting our product lines. Reporting directly to the Vice President / General Manager, you will play a pivotal role in aligning engineering strategies with business objectives, fostering a lean and innovative culture, and enhancing cross-functional collaboration to drive performance and continuous improvement.

Are you passionate about this work?

Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute strategic engineering plans that support company growth, efficiency, and innovation.
Team Development: Provide leadership, mentorship, and oversight to engineering managers across product lines, ensuring clear communication and alignment of departmental objectives. Build organizational capabilities through skills gap assessments, coaching, and professional development programs.
Performance Culture: Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams (Product Management, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, Service) to ensure engineering output aligns with business needs.
Project Oversight: Oversee project execution—including planning, resource management, timelines, and deliverables—ensuring on-time and within-budget completion.
Innovation Driver: Drive innovation, cost optimization, and design improvements without compromising product performance, quality, or safety.
Compliance: Maintain compliance with regulatory and internal standards, ensuring engineering practices meet industry and corporate benchmarks.

If this sounds like you, we want to connect!

Experience: 10+ years in progressive engineering roles, including at least 5 years leading cross‑functional engineering teams and managing complex technical projects in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related); MBA is a plus.
Leadership: Strong communicator with the ability to lead, inspire, and collaborate across all levels of the organization. Strong strategic thinking, solid analytical skills and decision-making capabilities.
Lean Expertise: Deep understanding and application of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles.
Project Management: Skilled in managing complex, multi-product line projects with competing priorities.
Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of industry regulations, safety standards, and engineering best practices.
Organizational Agility: Experience in matrixed or multi-line product organizations is considered an asset.

What’s in it for you?

There's no monopoly on innovative ideas or limits to how far you can advance with our team. We offer an open, communicative environment that fosters individual initiative. We pride ourselves in being a company where people are happy and choose to build a career.

In addition to growth opportunities, as a ProMach employee, you receive more than just a paycheck. Total compensation includes your salary, comprehensive medical/dental programs, as well as life insurance, a generous paid time off program, and a retirement savings plan with a company match. And because we understand the importance of feeling protected, there is no waiting period for benefits – you are eligible on your first day of employment!

Please note that the pay ranges listed on external job boards, outside our posting details, do not accurately reflect our internal compensation ranges.

Pro Mach, Inc.
was named to the Inc. 5,000 list of the fastest growing private companies in the U.S. seven times. We continue to introduce innovative products, enter new markets, expand our global presence, and actively acquire new capabilities.

We have the rewards, opportunities, and the market strength of a large organization combined with the entrepreneurial culture of a small, fast-paced company. You will enjoy the benefits of working with a growing company that competes globally, with the personal touch and feel of a smaller company where you can make an impact every day.

ProMach is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pro Mach uses E-Verify to verify employment eligibility of all new hires to work in the United States. Pro Mach is a drug-free workplace.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering, Transformation Team
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, AI Engineering, Transformation Team

Overview

The Transformation Team leads strategic change initiatives to reimagine how Mastercard works and scales, simplifies, and accelerates business outcomes. The team partners across leadership, product, technology, and operations to design and implement new organizational models, embed AI across key workflows, drive enterprise-wide transformation programs, improve operating effectiveness, and ensure successful adoption of change. By combining strategy, AI engineering, organizational design, change management, and program execution, the team helps align people, processes, and priorities to support long-term growth and business performance.

Role

This job develops and executes short-term and medium-term strategic plans for AI Engineering across Mastercard, aligning functional initiatives with organizational objectives by modifying existing methods to make significant improvements to existing processes, programs, and/or policies.
Drives the development and execution of short-term functional strategies for AI/ML teams, translating organizational priorities into actionable plans and deliverables.
Collaborates with product and business leaders to translate organizational needs into scalable AI solutions and operational strategies.
Oversees the ML engineering lifecycle of AI/ML projects, from architecture, design to deployment and monitoring, ensuring timely delivery within scope and budget.
Leads cross-functional teams in optimizing, fine-tuning, and deploying models that meet performance, robustness, and ethical standards, ensuring operational stability, scalability, and compliance of AI/ML systems, including model governance, ethical standards, and risk management.
Provides technical guidance and mentorship to senior technical leads, supporting their professional growth and ensuring technical excellence.
Serves as a key stakeholder and influencer in cross-functional initiatives, working closely with product managers, data scientists, and business units to align AI/ML solutions with strategic objectives.
Defines and refines best practices, standards, and methodologies for AI/ML optimization, deployment, and maintenance, ensuring consistency and high-quality outputs.
Contributes to organizational strategy by identifying emerging trends, evaluating new technologies, and recommending investments in AI/ML capabilities.

All About You

Strong hands-on understanding of transformer architectures and generative AI, including fine-tuning, prompting, embeddings, and evaluation
Experience bridging model development and real-world application, translating AI capabilities into business impact
Solid engineering background, with familiarity in Python, ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch/TensorFlow), and production deployment patterns
Experience working with data engineering and MLOps practices to support training, evaluation, and inference at scale
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical delivery to business priorities and measurable outcomes
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving AI landscape with ambiguity and shifting priorities
Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex AI concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering and Interconnection
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Director, Engineering and Interconnection to lead the owner's-side technical capability supporting Talen Energy's power generation, battery storage, and digital infrastructure development portfolio. The role is accountable for development-stage project engineering, technology and configuration decisions, technical diligence, and grid and transmission interconnection strategy. The Director will translate complex engineering and grid issues into clear decisions that improve safety, reliability, project economics, schedule certainty, and investment readiness.

Reporting to the Chief Asset Development Officer, the Director supports opportunities from early site screening through Final Investment Decision and transition to execution. The portfolio includes simple-cycle peakers and combined-cycle facilities using aeroderivative and large-frame F- and H-class gas turbines; standalone and co-located battery energy storage systems; and powered-land and data center projects requiring large-load interconnection and resilient power delivery. The role works across Talen's development functions and with PJM, transmission owners, utilities, OEMs, EPC contractors, the owner's engineer, and technical consultants. Detailed design and specialized studies may be external, but this role retains accountability for technical strategy, standards, decisions, risk, deliverable quality, and consultant performance.

Key Responsibilities

Build and lead the Engineering & Interconnection function, including development-stage standards, design criteria, stage-gate deliverables, review protocols, consultant governance, technical reporting, and scalable capability.
Support Site Origination by screening interconnection points, transmission and utility constraints, site layouts, fuel and water interfaces, constructability, and technical fatal flaws. Lead concept design and configuration for simple-cycle, combined-cycle, BESS, and powered-land or data center projects.
Evaluate technology tradeoffs involving output, efficiency, dispatch profile, emissions, water use, footprint, reliability, operating flexibility, lifecycle cost, and schedule. Direct preparation and review of design bases, heat and mass balances, one-lines, layouts, equipment lists, performance assumptions, utility requirements, and preliminary specifications.
Provide engineering inputs needed for permitting, estimating, contracting, and investment decisions, including plant configuration, emissions-control and stack assumptions, water and wastewater concepts, noise sources, site layouts, and construction requirements.
Lead technical evaluation and procurement support for gas turbines, battery systems, transformers, substations, switchyards, controls, and balance-of-plant systems, including technical scopes, proposal reviews, guarantees, lifecycle implications, vendor selection, and long-lead risks.
Select, direct, and hold accountable the owner's engineer, power-system and interconnection consultants, and other engineering specialists. Set acceptance criteria, challenge assumptions, manage quality, budget, and schedule, and resolve multidisciplinary interfaces before they create project risk.
Own engineering and interconnection work plans, budgets, schedules, assumptions, and risks. Develop or validate capital-cost estimates, operating assumptions, equipment lead times, contingencies, engineering maturity, and critical-path inputs for development and investment decisions.
Develop interconnection strategies for generation, storage, and large-load projects, including point-of-interconnection and queue strategy, generation and load-service pathways, co-location or behind-the-meter configurations, phased energization, redundancy, and alignment with target service dates.
Oversee interconnection applications, models, and studies; interpret results and quantify network upgrades, cost and schedule exposure, grid-performance requirements, security, milestone risk, and mitigation alternatives. Support technical provisions in related agreements.
Monitor PJM, transmission-owner, utility, FERC, NERC, and industry requirements; perform technical due diligence for acquisitions, partnerships, site reuse, and equipment opportunities; establish readiness criteria for stage gates and FID; and hand approved projects to Program Delivery and Construction, with targeted support through commissioning and performance testing.
Partner with Project Owners as the accountable technical lead for each opportunity, translating engineering and interconnection analysis into clear recommendations on project configuration, technical feasibility, interconnection pathway, cost and schedule implications, key risks and mitigation alternatives—providing the technical fact base and judgment needed to advance projects toward Final Investment Decisions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or another engineering discipline relevant to utility-scale power generation and electric power systems.
10+ years of progressive experience in power generation, transmission, interconnection, project engineering, or energy infrastructure, including substantial responsibility for development-stage work on complex capital projects.
Owner's-side, developer, owner's engineer, EPC, OEM, or utility experience advancing utility-scale projects from screening and concept design through front-end engineering, interconnection studies, FID, or notice to proceed.
Direct experience with simple-cycle and combined-cycle gas-fired generation, including aeroderivative gas turbines and large-frame F- and H-class technologies, together with experience with utility-scale battery energy storage systems.
Strong knowledge of generation and transmission interconnection processes, technical submissions, agreements, network upgrades, cost and schedule drivers, and grid-performance requirements in one or more organized ISO/RTO markets.
Ability to understand, review, and challenge power-flow, short-circuit, dynamic or transient-stability, reactive-power, deliverability, and related power-system studies without relying solely on summary conclusions.
Broad understanding of power-plant and power-delivery engineering, including mechanical systems, high-voltage systems, substations and switchyards, transmission interfaces, civil and structural design, controls, and plant utilities.
Success managing owner's engineers, consultants, OEMs, and EPC contractors; validating cost, schedule, performance, and risk inputs; and communicating complex technical issues to executives and nontechnical stakeholders. Ability to travel regularly as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional Engineer license and/or an advanced degree in engineering, engineering management, or business.
Direct experience with PJM interconnection processes, multiple PJM transmission owners, and projects in one or more PJM states; experience in adjacent competitive power markets is also valued.
Experience with powered-land, hyperscale data center, or other large-load development, including utility-service strategy, large-load interconnection, redundant power delivery, phased energization, and on-site generation or storage.
Experience with greenfield or brownfield development, existing-site reuse, project execution or operations, and common power-system analysis platforms and industry standards.

Leadership Profile

Owner-minded technical leader who accepts accountability for decisions, risk, and outcomes rather than simply coordinating consultants.
Combines deep engineering judgment with business and capital-allocation awareness; understands that the best technical answer must also be financeable, permittable, constructible, operable, and competitive.
Independent, intellectually rigorous, and decisive under incomplete information; tests assumptions, quantifies tradeoffs, recommends a path, and challenges weak conclusions before they become embedded in a project.
Collaborative capability builder who works effectively with Project Owners and peer functions while developing standards, tools, talent, consultant networks, and institutional knowledge that improve portfolio quality and speed.

Success Measures

Timely, decision-quality screening of new opportunities, with material engineering and interconnection fatal flaws identified before significant capital or schedule commitments.
Safe, reliable, technically competitive project configurations supported by credible design bases, performance assumptions, equipment strategies, capital costs, schedules, and lifecycle considerations.
Disciplined execution of PJM, transmission-owner, and utility interconnection processes, with complete submissions, met milestones, transparent upgrade exposure, and effective mitigation of grid-related risks.
Consistent technical readiness at stage gates and FID, with fewer late design changes, scope gaps, consultant rework, and engineering or interconnection surprises after capital approval, followed by complete handoffs to execution.
High-quality performance by the owner's engineer and other consultants, supported by repeatable standards, clear technical communication, strong cross-functional alignment, and credible external relationships.

Note:
You will have an opportunity to add attachments to your application. Please use this opportunity to upload your resume, cover letter, and any relevant documents .

jobs.title: Senior Director, Core Infrastructure Engineering, VCN Dataplane
jobs.description:
Job Description

Virtual Networking is foundational to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), providing the networking and storage datapath capabilities that customer workloads and OCI services depend on.

We are seeking a Senior Director to lead a geographically distributed organization responsible for VCN Dataplane software. You will own engineering strategy, architecture, delivery, and production operations, working with leaders across OCI to translate customer needs and business priorities into a clear technical roadmap.

This role combines deep systems expertise with organizational leadership. You will guide architectural decisions, scale a team of engineering managers and senior technical leaders, and maintain a high standard for performance, security, and availability. You will balance new capabilities with the engineering discipline required to operate critical infrastructure at cloud scale.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the engineering strategy and roadmap for VCN Dataplane in partnership with Product Management and engineering leaders across OCI.
Lead multiple engineering teams through design, development, testing, deployment, and production operations.
Guide architectural decisions across network virtualization, packet processing, and distributed systems, balancing performance, reliability, security, resource efficiency, and maintainability.
Own service health and operational outcomes, including availability, incident response, safe fleet deployments, and corrective actions that prevent recurring failures.

If you're energized and inspired by meaningful work, continuous development, and being part of a team that turns collective effort into real impact, we want to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application.

Remote status and role locations are subject to change, and relocation is not provided.

Job Summary & Responsibilities

The Director of Cloud Engineering is a senior engineering leader accountable for the strategy, architecture, and operational excellence of the company's multi-cloud platform. Reporting to the Sr. Director of IT Operations, this role owns the end-to-end cloud estate across Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Microsoft Azure, setting the technical direction for cloud-native infrastructure, platform engineering, and developer experience.

You will build and lead a high-performing distributed team of cloud engineers, SREs, and platform engineers while partnering closely with product, security, data, and application engineering to deliver a reliable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud foundation. This is a hands-on leadership role that balances deep technical credibility with the strategic thinking and organizational influence expected at the Director level.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Platform Strategy & Architecture

Define and own the multi-cloud architecture strategy across GCP and Azure, aligning platform capabilities with business objectives, scalability requirements, and total cost of ownership targets.
Lead architectural decisions for cloud-native workloads, including microservices, containerization (Kubernetes/GKE/AKS), serverless functions, and event-driven patterns.
Drive the evolution of the Internal Developer Platform (IDP), enabling self-service infrastructure provisioning, golden-path templates, and standardized deployment pipelines.
Establish and enforce cloud governance frameworks, including resource hierarchy, landing zones, policy-as-code, and guardrails across both cloud providers.
Evaluate emerging technologies—AI/ML infrastructure, LLMOps tooling, edge compute—and make build-vs-buy recommendations grounded in cost, risk, and strategic fit.

Infrastructure Engineering & Operations

Own Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards and practices; ensure all infrastructure changes flow through version-controlled, peer-reviewed pipelines.
Oversee GitOps workflows and CI/CD pipeline infrastructure, partnering with application teams to reduce deployment lead time and increase release frequency.
Direct SRE practices across the cloud estate: define and track SLIs/SLOs, drive blameless post-mortems, and lead reliability improvements through systematic error-budget management.
Own observability strategy—logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting—across cloud environments, ensuring engineers have actionable insight into system health and performance.
Lead disaster recovery design, runbook development, and regular DR/BCP testing exercises; drive remediation of identified gaps to closure.
Administer and maintain all Microsoft licensing through NCE and MPSA agreements
Maintain network architecture and connectivity across cloud environments, data centers, and supported locations, including VPN, private connectivity (Interconnect/ExpressRoute), and DNS.

Security, Compliance & Risk

Partner with the Security team to implement Zero Trust network architecture, enforce least-privilege IAM, and operationalize Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) tooling.
Ensure cloud environments meet regulatory and compliance requirements; support internal and external audits by providing architecture documentation, access logs, and control evidence.
Define and maintain cloud security baselines, secrets management practices, and data encryption standards across the shared responsibility model.
Drive incident response processes for cloud infrastructure events, ensuring timely escalation, containment, and root-cause resolution.

FinOps & Cloud Cost Management

Own the cloud infrastructure budget; implement FinOps practices including cost allocation tagging, chargeback/showback reporting, reserved capacity planning, and rightsizing recommendations.
Establish cloud cost visibility and governance mechanisms so engineering teams can make cost-aware architecture decisions in real time.
Negotiate vendor agreements and manage strategic relationships with GCP, Azure, and key third-party tooling providers.

AI-Enabled Cloud Engineering

 Evaluate, integrate, and champion the responsible use of AI tools across cloud engineering and platform teams, setting standards for AI-driven productivity and innovation.

 Treat AI as a productivity multiplier, not a replacement — ensuring engineers maintain sound engineering judgment and that AI-generated code and configuration meet the same quality, security, and reliability standards as hand-written work.

Leadership & People Management

Lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of cloud engineers, platform engineers, and SREs (onshore and offshore); establish clear career ladders and development paths.
Build a team culture grounded in psychological safety, continuous learning, and engineering excellence; champion internal tech talks, documentation habits, and knowledge sharing.
Manage headcount planning, recruiting, and onboarding; partner with HR and technical leads to define roles and evaluate candidates.
Deliver timely, constructive performance reviews; proactively manage performance issues and recognize high-impact contributions.
Serve as a technical escalation path and executive sponsor for major infrastructure initiatives; represent the cloud engineering team in IT governance and steering forums.

Experience

Preferred Qualifications

15+ years in IT/infrastructure engineering, with at least 8 years focused on public cloud platforms (GCP and/or Azure).
5+ years in a senior engineering leadership role (Director, Principal, or Staff Engineer equivalent) managing teams of 8 or more engineers across onshore and offshore locations.
Demonstrated hands-on proficiency with both GCP and Azure services, including but not limited to: GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Armor, BigQuery, VPC Service Controls (GCP) and AKS, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, ExpressRoute, and Entra ID (Azure).
Proven track record delivering large-scale cloud migrations, re-architecture projects, or greenfield platform builds in a regulated or enterprise environment.
Deep expertise with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform required; Pulumi or CDK a plus) and GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent).
Experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines at enterprise scale (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, Azure DevOps, or equivalent).
Direct experience with FinOps practices: cloud cost allocation, tagging governance, reserved instance/committed-use optimization, and budget reporting.
Familiarity with SRE principles: SLI/SLO frameworks, error budgets, chaos engineering, and reliability-focused incident management.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related engineering discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Certifications

At least one of: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or Microsoft Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or maturing an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) using tools such as Backstage, Crossplane, or similar platform-engineering frameworks.
Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure on GCP (Vertex AI) or Azure (Azure AI Studio, Azure Machine Learning) and an understanding of LLMOps patterns such as model serving, inference optimization, and vector database infrastructure.
Working knowledge of service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd) and zero-trust network segmentation at the workload level.
Experience with cloud-native observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, or Google Cloud Operations Suite).
Familiarity with enterprise IT governance frameworks such as ITIL v4, COBIT 2019, or TOGAF; direct experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA/PCI-DSS compliance programs.
Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry where cloud security posture and audit readiness are operationally critical.
Additional certifications: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Google Cloud Professional Security Engineer, or AWS Solutions Architect (for multi-cloud context).

Pay Range

$152,700-$200,000 per year

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities.

Inspira provides industry-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program.

Partner with integrated platform (ITS infrastructure and operations) and data teams (data governance, interoperability, reporting, research informatics, data science, analytics etc.) to define integrated solutions that meet the evolving needs of data analysts, developers and consumers (e.g. data ingestion framework, AI/ML capabilities, scalable compute), contributing to the innovation and leadership of the data organization

Summary

The Director of Systems Engineering, Integration & Test (SEIT) is a senior technical and

organizational leader responsible for establishing, guiding, and assuring CAE’s integrated systems engineering, system architecture, verification, validation, and test execution activities across assigned programs. This role provides unified leadership over requirements development, change management, systems design, integration readiness, test program planning, and product acceptance assuring all engineering processes, artifacts, certifications, and test outcomes meet CAE, customer, and regulatory standards.

The SEIT Director leads a multidisciplinary team spanning systems engineers, architects,

integration engineers, test directors, instructional design, systems/software/hardware interface specialists, cyber engineering contributors, and verification/validation personnel. The Director

sets vision, defines processes, enforces engineering rigor, and drives execution excellence across the full lifecycle.

Strategic & Organizational Leadership

Serve as the authority for engineering processes, systems engineering plans, integration plans, test approaches, and verification/validation frameworks.

Integration & Test Leadership

A tolling technology leader with deep expertise in electronic toll collection, back-office and roadside systems, multi-lane free-flow (MLFF) technology, interoperability frameworks, and large-scale tolling modernization. You understand how to help agencies and infrastructure operators deploy, integrate, and evolve complex tolling technology platforms while balancing operational performance, financial objectives, customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and cybersecurity considerations. The Wor
k:

Lead the growth and expansion of Accenture's Smart Mobility Hub tolling technology portfolio across North America, with a focus on back-office modernization, roadside systems, and interoperability platforms.

Originate, qualify, shape, and support closure of strategic tolling technology opportunities, including back-office platform replacements, MLFF deployments, interoperability integrations, and end-to-end system modernizations.

Lead and grow Accenture’s customer service operations technology practice within the tolling portfolio, encompassing contact center platforms, CRM systems, self-service digital channels, workforce management tools, omnichannel customer engagement, and AI-powered service automation for tolling agencies and operators.

Shape technology offerings across tolling back-office modernization (CSC, violations, collections), roadside and MLFF systems, electronic payment and account management platforms, customer service operations technology, interoperability hubs, revenue assurance, cybersecurity, data analytics, and AI/ML enablement for tolling operations.

Collaborate across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, Song, and ecosystem partners to create integrated client solutions.

Lead industry thought leadership through client forums, conferences, associations, publications, and executive roundtables.

Recruit, mentor, and develop tolling technology practitioners — including systems architects, integration engineers, and platform specialists — while strengthening succession planning and technical industry capability.

Bring disciplined portfolio management, forecasting, and operational governance to pursuits and delivery programs.

A minimum of 12 years of experience in tolling technology, electronic toll collection, transportation systems integration, back-office platforms, roadside technology, or a closely related infrastructure technology field.

Demonstrated experience managing executive client relationships and engaging with C-suite, agency, authority, or senior public-sector leaders.

Demonstrated experience shaping business opportunities, strategic pursuits, proposals, or market growth initiatives.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

You have leadership of major transportation technology portfolios or multi-program delivery organizations with P&L, forecasting, margin, or cash-flow accountability.

Job Title:
Director, AI Automation Engineer

Location:
Remote US

Reports to:
SVP, Product | AI

Full-time, exempt

Who We Are

Impiricus is the Agentic Commercialization Platform for Healthcare. We help life sciences teams understand physician intent, coordinate the right clinical and commercial resources, and enable real-time action when HCPs need support. Our AI-powered platform acts as a field force multiplier: extending reach between rep visits, prioritizing the highest-impact path for each physician, and connecting HCPs to coverage, evidence, medical information, patient support, MSLs, field teams, samples, and approved content in the moments that matter.

Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was built to accelerate patient access to life-saving treatments through ethical, physician-first engagement. More than one million opted-in HCPs trust Impiricus as a preferred channel, including many who are underserved or hard to reach through traditional outreach. Products such as the Intelligently Optimized Network (ION), Pulse, Spark, and Ascend work together so every interaction can move from information to action. Guided by our Physician Advisory Board, we keep engagement clinically meaningful, compliant, and grounded in better patient care.

Job Summary

The Director, AI Automation Engineer is a player-coach role: own the quality and reliability layer for everything the AI Organization ships, and stay hands-on building the harnesses, eval frameworks, and release gates that make that real.

That means automated testing infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and CI/CD guardrails that let us stage, test, and manage AI agents and tools at scale. Coverage spans internal AI platform work (Sage and the tools built on it) and customer-facing AI across Ascend and DocUpdate.

This is the first dedicated hire into a function we expect to grow. The Director sets the bar, does the hardest technical work early, and grows into leading a small automation team as coverage expands. The goal is to keep AI Engineers and builders shipping without loading QA burden onto the core build team.

Partnership is daily with AI Engineers, AI Solutions Architects, and product teams shipping AI features: establish baseline quality metrics, automate validation, and make standards usable for engineers and non-engineers building in Sage.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Harness and Infrastructure

Own the infrastructure that continuously verifies whether autonomous agents are taking the actions we intend, before and after they reach production.
Stage, test, and lifecycle-manage bots and agent workflows before they reach production.
Establish baseline quality metrics and coverage standards for AI initiatives.
Build the infrastructure to run automated research chains and agent evals at scale.

Evaluation Frameworks

Create automated evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs: accuracy, safety, bias, and regression.
Implement RAG evaluation, prompt regression testing, and golden-set benchmarking.
Define and enforce quality thresholds that AI Engineers and builders must meet before ship.
Partner with AI Researchers and Engineers on eval design for new model and agent patterns.

CI/CD and Release Quality

Build the release-gating infrastructure that governs when an agent is trusted to act in production, including staged rollouts and rollback authority.
Develop AI automation solutions to ensure that agentic coding delivers highly functioning software while maintaining quality across the product portfolio
Integrate testing into GitHub Actions (or equivalent) for AI model and agent releases.
Maintain existing test suites and keep them current as models, prompts, and tools change.

Cross-Team Quality Partnership

Work with AI Solutions Architects on eval criteria for workflow automations they build in the field.
Partner with Principal AI Product on launch-readiness and QA for AI projects across the org.
Support product teams (Ascend, DocUpdate, Platform) on AI feature validation without owning their roadmaps.
Document standards, runbooks, and patterns so non-engineers building in Sage can self-serve basic testing.

Qualifications & Experience

5+ years building, evaluating, or governing production AI/ML systems, with direct experience in agentic AI, LLM-based automation, or autonomous system safety
Direct experience evaluating LLM outputs: RAG eval, prompt regression, safety and accuracy benchmarking.
Experience building CI/CD pipelines with integrated test gates (GitHub Actions or similar).
Comfortable working across AI platform infrastructure and product-facing AI features.
Operates independently as a senior IC and communicates quality standards to engineers and non-engineers.
Experience with agent testing, bot lifecycle management, or AI agent orchestration platforms is a strong plus.
Familiarity with LLM observability and eval tooling (LangSmith, Braintrust, custom harnesses, etc.) is a strong plus.
Background in healthcare, pharma, or regulated environments where quality gates matter is a strong plus.
Prior experience standing up a QA or automation function from scratch, with appetite to grow into leading a team.
Proficiency in Python and standard testing frameworks (pytest or equivalent).

Compensation And Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $185,000 - $210,000

Where you land within the range will reflect your skills, experience, and location, while keeping team parity in mind and leaving room for future growth.

Important Notice

To protect candidates, please note that all communication from our team will come directly from an @impiricus.com email address. We do not engage third party recruiters to schedule interviews for this role. If you receive outreach from anyone outside of our domain claiming to represent Impiricus, please disregard and let us know by forwarding the message to careers@impiricus.com

Impiricus focuses on taking care of our teammates' professional and personal growth and well-being.

Flexible Time Off
: Take the time you need with a flexible vacation policy — recharge your batteries your way

Parental Leave

Your Work, Your Way
: If you're close to an office, we encourage spending some time in-person to collaborate and connect. If not, remote is always an option.

401(k)
: Save for your future with tax advantages (and company match!)

jobs.title: VP, Intelligent Banking Platform
jobs.description:
Job Overview

PenFed is hiring a (Hybrid) VP, Intelligent Banking Platform at our Tysons, Virginia location. The primary purpose of this position is to own the architecture, engineering, and continuous delivery of PenFed's first-party member digital banking platform, serving approximately three million members across web and native mobile.

The credit union builds and operates its own member experience and orchestration layers rather than relying solely on a packaged digital banking front end. The platform is supported by enterprise CRM, data, AI, analytics, and integration capabilities, and connects to the credit union's core banking and product systems of record. This role is accountable for the member-facing platform layers and their integrations; operational ownership of the underlying systems of record resides with designated enterprise technology and business owners, and the credit union retains institutional responsibility for the oversight of all third-party and vendor-provided services.

This role owns the platform and architecture behind a member experience aims to be predictive, insightful, and anticipatory - conversational and agent-enabled where those modalities genuinely serve the member, and deliberately not where they do not. The incumbent is accountable for the capability model, information model, and integration contracts that govern how that platform evolves, and for the engineering organization that builds and operates it, working in alignment with enterprise technology, security, data, risk, and compliance standards.

Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of job duties and the position will perform other duties as assigned.

Own end-to-end architecture and delivery of the member-facing digital banking platform across authenticated web and native mobile, including availability, performance, resiliency, and member-impacting incident response.
Define and maintain the consumer banking capability model and information model, and steward canonical definitions of member, relationship, household, account, and consent through applicable enterprise data-governance processes across servicing, lending, deposits, and marketing.
Set the target-state architecture for the platform's experience and orchestration layers within the assigned banking technology domain and govern the integration contracts through which the core ledger, card processor, payments, deposits, and lending providers are consumed.
Partner across enterprise security, data, cloud, infrastructure, risk, and compliance disciplines to establish and execute the target state, ensuring platform architecture conforms to enterprise standards without duplicating or displacing those functions' accountability.
Lead the architecture, engineering, evaluation, and production deployment of approved agent-enabled experiences, orchestration, and automation - implemented within applicable security, privacy, risk, compliance, and human-oversight frameworks - including bounded action registries, data grounding, policy constraints, human-oversight thresholds, auditability, and reversibility requirements for member-affecting actions.
Establish and enforce a modality doctrine defining when conversational, agent-enabled, and direct-manipulation interactions are appropriate, grounded in member outcome, reversibility of the action, and regulatory exposure.
Partner with the enterprise AI program, Enterprise Risk, and Compliance to operate within the credit union's AI governance and responsible AI standards; provide the technical evidence, documentation, and lineage required for internal audit, examination, and third-party assessment.
Drive the unified member profile, including identity resolution, householding, consent management, and data quality sufficient to support predictive and anticipatory member experiences.
Partner with Consumer Lending, Deposits, Cards, Home Lending, and Marketing leadership to shape and sequence the digital roadmap, translating product and P&L objectives into platform capability and delivery commitments.
Own build, buy, and configure decisions for the platform layers within the role's assigned scope, supported by capability-level evidence rather than preference, and articulate those decisions to executive leadership and governance bodies as required.
Advance continuous delivery, automated testing, secure development practice, and observability across the digital engineering organization, with measurable improvement in deployment frequency, change failure rate, and time to restore service.
Ensure the platform and engineering practices within the role's assigned scope support compliance with applicable laws, regulations, supervisory guidance, and enterprise control frameworks - including, as applicable, consumer protection, fair lending, privacy, information security, electronic funds transfer, AI and model risk, third-party risk, and technology resilience requirements. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Privacy, and Information Security on the interpretation and implementation of those requirements.
Ensure the platform can faithfully implement, transmit, display, and audit compliant outcomes originating from the responsible business and lending functions, including accurate and specific adverse action reasoning where decisioning is surfaced through digital channels.
Serve as the senior technical representative for the member digital platform in examination, internal audit, and third-party assessment activity, including evidence of control ownership, data lineage, and change management.
Manage third-party delivery partners, systems integrators, and platform vendors, including contractual performance, roadmap dependency, and concentration risk, in accordance with the credit union's third-party risk management program.
Build, lead, and develop a director-level leadership team across platform engineering, mobile, architecture, and AI-enabled capability; establish clear decision rights and succession depth within the organization.
Represent the digital platform in enterprise architecture, technology investment, and risk governance forums, and act as a credible technical voice with business-line leadership on member experience and product economics.
Promote a culture of engineering excellence, psychological safety, and continuous improvement across employee and partner teams.
Ensure employees and contingent workers within the function complete required information security training and adhere to applicable security policies; promptly escalate suspected policy violations or security incidents to Information Security, Human Resources, Legal, or other designated functions in accordance with established procedures.

*This role is responsible for ensuring business continuity.*

Qualifications

Equivalent combination of education and experience is considered.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or MIS.
Minimum of twelve (12) years of progressive experience in software engineering, platform architecture, or digital product engineering, including at least five (5) years leading managers and/or multidisciplinary technology organizations with accountability for talent, budgets, delivery commitments, organizational performance, and technology decision-making.
Minimum of eight (8) years in banking, credit union, or fintech environments, with demonstrated fluency in consumer banking economics including interchange, deposit pricing, loss performance, funding cost, and origination unit economics.
Experience must include direct accountability for the architecture and engineering of a first-party or substantially custom member- or customer-facing platform operating in production at scale under regulatory supervision. Experience solely implementing or configuring a packaged digital banking platform is insufficient.
Depth in the Salesforce ecosystem - including Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce - with the technical judgment to distinguish appropriate platform extension from accumulating technical debt.
Experience delivering and operating native mobile applications at consumer scale, including release management, device fragmentation, and mobile-specific security controls.
Experience with cloud-native architecture, event-driven integration, API design and management, modern analytics platforms, continuous delivery pipelines, and the consumption of enterprise identity and authentication services in a member-facing context.
Working knowledge of applied AI and agent-enabled system design, including retrieval and grounding patterns, evaluation, guardrails, and the operational controls required to deploy such systems in a regulated environment.
Familiarity with the supervisory landscape governing consumer digital banking at a [federally chartered / state-chartered, federally insured] credit union, including [NCUA / NCUA and applicable state] supervisory priorities and third-party risk expectations, FFIEC guidance, GLBA, Regulation E, Regulation B/ECOA, and UDAAP considerations in personalization and targeting.
Familiarity with recognized control and risk frameworks applied to technology and AI, including the AICPA Trust Services Criteria used in SOC 2 examinations, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and enterprise risk management principles, and the ability to translate evolving supervisory direction into practical platform controls.
Demonstrated experience defining and applying business and information architecture - capability models, canonical data definitions, and integration contracts - as instruments of decision-making rather than documentation exercises.
Experience working with third-party delivery models, including offshore and nearshore teams, and managing systems integrator and vendor performance.
Strong influencing skills, with a track record of establishing credibility with both engineering organizations and business-line leadership, and of driving alignment without positional authority.
Strong change management experience in complex, regulated organizations.
Exceptional analytical, written, verbal, presentation, and executive-level communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership, audit committees, or examiners.
Experience using A.I. tools preferred.

Supervisory Responsibility

This position will supervise employees.
This position will also have matrix leadership responsibilities.
This position may manage contractual performance of third-party resources.

Licenses and Certifications

Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) preferred. Salesforce Certified System Architect, Salesforce Certified Application Architect, or equivalent demonstrated experience architecting complex, integrated Salesforce platforms at enterprise scale will also be considered.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to an indoor office setting with moderate noise.

*Most roles require working in an office setting with moderate noise and the ability to lift 25 pounds.*

Travel

Ability to travel to various worksites and be on-call is required.

Pay Transparency

The anticipated starting salary OR hourly range for this role is $ 152,200 .00 - $ 309,960.00

This position is eligible for an organizational performance based annual bonus, subject to board discretion and approval.

This position is eligible for an individual performance based annual bonus.

At PenFed, we offer a robust benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. You'll have access to comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans; paid time off; and family-friendly benefits like paid parental leave, care support, and fitness center access. Financial wellness is encouraged through features like a 401(k) match, employee loan disc

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Enterprise AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.

The Role

The Senior Manager, Enterprise AI Engineering
will lead a team focused on turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into practical solutions for teams across Match Group.

You will partner with functions including Finance, Legal, People, Marketing, Communications, and Operations to identify high-value opportunities, rapidly build and deploy AI-powered solutions, and scale what works across the organization.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a builder who can move comfortably between business problems and technical solutions. You’ll work with functional leaders, domain experts, Engineering, Data, IT, Security, and Privacy to take ideas from prototypes to reliable, reusable enterprise capabilities.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow a team of AI engineers focused on delivering high-impact enterprise solutions across the organization.

Build and own AI infrastructure

Lead design and development of AI powered tools, agents, retrieval systems, automations, and services
Own and evolve core AI architecture - LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, native and custom integrations, centralized app and dashboard deployment, and model access management
Shepherd solutions from prototype through production in close partnership with Engineering, Data, IT, Legal, Security, and Privacy

Drive adoption and standardization

Partner with brand AI leads and engineering leads across teams to establish shared infrastructure and avoid duplicated effort
Define engineering practices and technical standards for building reliable, secure, and scalable AI applications
Connect related AI initiatives and actively share technology and learnings across teams

Evaluate And Expand Capabilities

Evaluate, pilot, and roll out new models, tools, and platform feature in collaboration with legal and Security
Build frameworks to measure quality, reliability, adoption, and business impact

Be the connective tissue

Manage vendor relationships and internal stakeholder expectations
Partner with functional leaders and domain experts to identify and prioritize high-impact AI opportunities and ensure solutions are grounded in real business needs

Who You Are

A hands-on technical leader who enjoys building as much as leading.
Experienced with modern AI technologies, including LLMs, agents, RAG, evaluations, model selection, and workflow automation.
Comfortable with APIs, data, integrations, cloud architectures, security, and enterprise systems.
Able to translate ambiguous business problems into practical technical solutions.
Pragmatic and outcome-oriented. You care about solving meaningful problems rather than using AI for its own sake.
Effective at building trust and driving complex initiatives across technical, business, and executive stakeholders.
Curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a field where capabilities and best practices evolve rapidly.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of relevant engineering and management experience, including meaningful hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered products or systems and managing teams of engineers.
Experience building applications using modern generative AI technologies, including LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG, evaluations, and model APIs.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems, APIs, integrations, and data-driven applications.
Experience taking AI or emerging technologies from prototype through production and adoption.
Experience leading engineers and complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to work directly with business stakeholders and domain experts to translate problems into working solutions.
Excellent communication skills across technical, business, and executive audiences.

Preferred

Experience building enterprise AI products or platforms used across multiple business functions.
Experience with enterprise AI architecture, cloud infrastructure, security, data integration, and governance.
Experience designing evaluation and monitoring frameworks for generative AI systems.
Experience creating reusable platforms, services, or components from initially specialized use cases.
Experience scaling emerging technologies within a large organization.

Our Values

Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect all of us to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

jobs.title: DIRECTOR - CHIEF - RM ENGINEERING
jobs.description:
Pyramid Global Hospitality is a leading hospitality management company with a portfolio of more than 200 hotels and resorts and over 18,000 associates across the United States, Caribbean, and Europe. Our platform includes Benchmark Resorts & Hotels, a collection of distinctive independent properties; Axiom Hospitality, our European hotel management company; and PYRAMIDWORKS, which provides integrated workplace and facilities services. With corporate offices in Boston, The Woodlands, Texas, and London, Pyramid combines global scale with a hands-on approach focused on exceptional service, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships.

At Pyramid, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where associates are respected, supported, and empowered to grow their careers. Team members have the opportunity to collaborate directly with experienced leaders, take on meaningful stretch assignments, and gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of properties, brands, and markets. Whether you are beginning your hospitality career or bringing years of experience, you'll find opportunities to learn, develop, and make an impact.

Our commitment to associates, guests, owners, and the communities we serve has helped make Pyramid and our properties among the most recognized in hospitality. From being named among the best places to work by respected publications such as USA Today, The Boston Globe, and The Houston Chronicle to earning top travel accolades from Travel + Leisure, Condé Nast Traveler, Forbes Travel Guide, and U.S. News & World Report, these recognitions reflect the culture, service excellence, and commitment to people that define the Pyramid experience.

About Our Property

The Hilton Philadelphia at Penn’s Landing is a great place to stay during your visit to Philadelphia. Its location is unique: it’s the only hotel located directly on the Delaware River Waterfront at Penn’s Landing in Philadelphia’s downtown. The Hilton Philadelphia at Penn’s Landing’s 350 well-appointed guest rooms and 24,000 square feet of meeting space offer an experience that is hard to match. The guest rooms are fitted with sleek work desks, along with 32” LCD televisions and wall-mounted, plug-n-play consoles for Wi-Fi internet access. Dark wood furnishings, leather lounge chairs, contemporary lighting and gorgeous bathrooms complete the newly renovated guest rooms, which also come with stunning city or river views.

What You Will Have An Opportunity To Do

This hands-on leader is responsible for maintaining a safe, fully functional and well-presented property while operating within a lean staffing and budget model. This role balances technical expertise, preventative maintenance and responsive guest service to minimize downtime, control costs and protect the asset—all while ensuring brand standards and life-safety requirements are consistently met.

Essential Functions

Perform and oversee daily maintenance and repairs across guest rooms and public areas.
Maintain and troubleshoot HVAC, electrical, plumbing, water heaters and lighting.
Executive a structured preventative maintenance program.
Prioritize repairs that directly impact guest satisfaction and QA scores.
Ensure compliance with fire and life safety systems.
Manage call coverage for evenings, weekends and emergencies.
Reduce downtime and service calls through proactive maintenance.
Respond quickly to guest maintenance issues with professionalism and a service-first mindset.
Work closely with other departments, including front office and housekeeping, to enhance the guest experience.
Coordinate specialized vendors as needed and monitor contractor work to ensure safety, quality and cost expectations.

What are we looking for?

Other Duties

Follows all company and safety and security policies and procedures.
Completes safety training and certifications.
Have a thorough understanding of OSHA rules and regulations.
Ensures uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional.
Maintains confidentiality of proprietary information.
Protects company assets.
Welcomes and acknowledges all guests according to company stand Guest Rooms: plunging toilets, unclogging drains, repairing all types of plumbing hardware.
Public Areas: plunging toilets, unclogging drains, repairing all types of plumbing hardware.
Energy Conservation: to observe energy and utilities usage in the hotel and on the grounds. To look for ways to conserve energy and report any ideas to Engineering Management.
Tools: clean, lubricate, protect, and otherwise maintain all tools and equipment in the hotel. To see that all tools used are returned to the shop and secured in proper storage area. To protect and otherwise maintain your assigned tool pouch and its tools at the discretion of the Engineering Management.
Emergencies: Be available for any emergencies and act in an engineering capacity to protect our guests and associates and preserve the building and its systems during the emergency. To act as quickly and responsibly as possible to return the building to its normal operating status. To inform Engineering Management of any such emergencies.
Accident Prevention and Safety: to strive to work in an accident-free manner and to create a safe work environment for others. To continuously look for conditions which may endanger associates or guests of the hotel and to take immediate action to correct any hazardous conditions found.
Records: to read, log, track and interpret reading from meters, gauges, and other measuring units. To maintain a thorough log of each day’s activities and problems that occur and to ensure this information is passed on to other shifts.
Departmental Duties: to clean all engineering areas as directed by Engineering Management. To work in a neat and efficient manner, keeping work areas clean and well organized. To serve as otherwise directed or needed to help maintain the effective and efficient operation of the hotel.
General: Complete all work assigned in a safe and professional manner. Maintain communications with supervisors to ensure that all needed materials, tools, and supplies are available or on order. Follow up on any items that may be on back order. Keep supervisor updated on assignments. Provide training and technical advice to other engineers as needed or requested.
Conducts room plumbing preventative maintenance on all hotel rooms, buildings, and equipment.
Assists guests as needed.
Assists with security and safety checks for the property through visual checks.

We provide process development, produce GMP viral vectors, and provide cell transduction for gene and cell therapy clinical trials and are proud to be a part of the process that leads to new cures.

WORKING AT GENEZEN

Many people have worked in environments where you feel like just another nameless part of an enormous machine. Genezen is different. We want our employees to be innovative, collaborative problem solvers who are dedicated to meeting the challenges of working at a fast-growing company. We are dedicated to empowering our employees to be their best and making Genezen a rewarding place to work. Every employee contributes to the success of the company and you can be part of that team.

JOB SUMMARY

The Process Engineering Manager/Sr. Manager is responsible for leading the process engineering department at Genezen’s Lexington facility. The incumbent will act as the key decision maker implementing program enhancements and overseeing equipment onboarding and process improvements. The candidate will establish goals and priorities their staff and act as the primary liaison between both internal customers and external service providers. The Process Engineering Manager/Sr. Manager will represent Engineering as the subject matter expert for all engineering related topics during client facing project meetings and be responsible for the department deliverables.

A tolling technology professional with strong program leadership capabilities and experience delivering complex electronic toll collection, back-office modernization, roadside systems, customer service operations technology, and interoperability initiatives. You understand the technical and operational environment of tolling agencies and infrastructure operators and can translate business and technology requirements into executable delivery plans. You are comfortable leading multidisciplinary engineering and consulting teams, managing client stakeholders across technology and operations, establishing governance, resolving delivery challenges, and driving measurable outcomes. You bring deep tolling technology knowledge, operational discipline, sound judgment, financial awareness, and a collaborative leadership style that helps teams perform at their best.

The Work:

Lead delivery of tolling technology modernization programs — including back-office platform implementations, MLFF/AET roadside deployments, customer service operations technology, and interoperability integrations — from planning through implementation and operational transition.

Manage program governance, scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, quality, forecasting, and executive reporting.

Lead and support technology modernization initiatives spanning tolling back-office systems (CSC, violations, collections), customer service operations technology (contact center platforms, CRM, self-service digital channels, omnichannel engagement), roadside and MLFF systems, interoperability hubs, revenue assurance, data analytics, and AI/ML-enabled tolling operations.

Lead cross-functional teams spanning systems architecture, software engineering, systems integration, operations, customer service technology, data and analytics, and organizational change management.

Develop tolling technology delivery plans, system integration roadmaps, business cases, technical operating models, functional and non-functional requirements, and phased implementation strategies.

Partner with tolling agency and private-sector technology stakeholders to identify operational and technology improvement opportunities and translate them into sustainable, scalable delivery outcomes across tolling and customer service platforms.

Coach consultants and managers, strengthen delivery capability, and promote consistent project management and quality practices.

Use data and forward-looking performance indicators to improve decision-making, accountability, and delivery predictability.

A minimum of 8 years of experience in tolling technology, electronic toll collection, back-office or roadside systems, customer service operations technology, transportation systems integration, or a closely related infrastructure technology field.

Experience managing client stakeholders, cross-functional teams, budgets, schedules, risks, quality, and delivery reporting.

Experience with at least one of the following: tolling back-office platforms, electronic toll collection technology, customer service operations technology (contact centers, CRM, self-service), MLFF/AET roadside systems, interoperability frameworks, violations and collections systems, or revenue assurance platforms.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

You have hands-on experience with electronic toll collection technology, customer account management platforms, billing, violations processing, enforcement workflows, interoperability protocols (e.g., E-ZPass, ETAN), contact center or CRM systems, self-service digital channels, or revenue assurance platforms.

You have experience supporting tolling authorities, transportation agencies, state departments of transportation, concessionaires, or public-private partnerships.

You have experience with design-build, field deployment, testing, commissioning, acceptance, or complex system integration.

You have experience applying Power BI, predictive analytics, AI/ML-enabled tools, computer vision, cloud-native platforms, or AI-powered service automation to improve tolling technology delivery, customer service operations, or revenue performance.
